author: nickyeow

english.text: I like the singer's voice, too.

text: 我都好鍾意嗰個歌手把聲。

jyutping: ngo5 giu3 nei5 dim2 zou6，nei5 zau6 dim2 zou6。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It's time for you to buy a new car.

jyutping: nei5 hai6 si4 hau6 maai5 faan1 gaa3 san1 ce1 laa3 wo3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My father died three years ago, that is to say in 1977.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 hai6 saam1 nin4 cin4 gwo3 saang1 ge3，ze1 hai6 jat1 gau2 cat1 cat1 nin4。
text: 我阿爸係三年前過生嘅，啫係一九七七年。

author: nickyeow

jyutping: ceot1 heoi3 zi1 cin4 gei3 zyu6 sik1 saai3 di1 dang1 keoi5 wo3。
text: 出去之前記住熄晒啲燈佢喎。

english.text: Do you know why spring rolls are called spring rolls?

english.text: Peavey and her husband run one of the oldest sheep ranches in this part of Idaho. They decided to become proactive, to share their heritage with the recreationists, the vacation home owners and other new arrivals. Now every fall, one of the local sheep ranching families trails their flock right through the center of the resort town. It's turned into an annual festival called the Trailing of the Sheep.

jyutping: Peavey tung4 keoi5 lou5 gung1 hai2 oi3 daat6 ho4 zau1 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 ging1 jing4 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 zeoi3 gu2 lou5 ge3 joeng4 muk6 coeng4。 keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 bin3 dak1 zyu2 dung6，tung4 jyu4 lok6 jan4 si6、dou6 gaa3 uk1 jip6 zyu2 tung4 kei4 taa1 san1 lai4 ge3 jan4 fan1 hoeng2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 wai4 caan2。ji4 gaa1 mui5 nin4 cau1 tin1，dong1 dei6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 joeng5 joeng4 gaa1 ting4 dou1 wui5 gan1 zyu6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 joeng4 kwan4 cyun1 gwo3 dou6 gaa3 cyun1 ge3 zung1 sam1。 keoi5 bin3 sing4 zo2 jat1 go3 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 geoi2 hang4 ge3 zit3 jat6，giu3 zou6「zeoi1 joeng4」。
text: Peavey 同佢老公喺愛達荷州呢個地方經營其中一個最古老嘅羊牧場。 佢哋決定變得主動，同娛樂人士、度假屋業主同其他新嚟嘅人分享佢哋嘅遺產。而家每年秋天，當地其中一個養羊家庭都會跟住佢哋嘅羊群穿過度假村嘅中心。 佢變成咗一個每年都會舉行嘅節日，叫做「追羊」。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Never has youth been exposed to such dangers of both perversion and arrest as in our own land and day. Increasing urban life with its temptations, prematurities, sedentary occupations, and passive stimuli just when an active life is most needed, early emancipation and a lessening sense for both duty and discipline, the haste to know and do all befitting man's estate before its time, the mad rush for sudden wealth and the reckless fashions set by its gilded youth--all these lack some of the regulatives they still have in older lands with more conservative conditions.

jyutping: cing1 nin4 cung4 loi4 dou1 mou5 zip3 zuk1 gwo3 hou2 ci5 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 ge3 tou2 dei6 tung4 si4 doi6 gam2 ge3 bin3 taai3 tung4 bei6 bou6 ge3 ngai4 him2。hai2 zeoi3 seoi1 jiu3 zyu2 dung6 saang1 wut6 ge3 si4 hau6，sing4 si5 saang1 wut6 zau6 zang1 gaa1 zo2 jau5 waak6、zou2 caan2、gau2 zo6 ge3 zik1 jip6 tung4 bei6 dung6 ci3 gik1，zou2 kei4 ge3 gaai2 fong3 tung4 deoi3 ji6 mou6 tung4 gei2 leot6 ge3 gam2 gok3 gaam2 joek6，gap1 jyu1 zi1 dou3 tung4 zou6 so2 jau5 sik1 hap6 ge3 si6，ling6 dou3 jan4 leoi6 ge3 coi4 fu3 dat6 jin4 bei6 cung4 san1 daa2 zou6 cing1 nin4 —— so2 jau5 ni1 di1 dou1 kyut3 fat6 jat1 di1 keoi5 dei6 hai2 gaau3 bou2 sau2 ge3 gau6 tou2 dei6 soeng6 jing4 jin4 jau5 ge3 kwai1 gun2 cou3 si1。
text: 青年從來都冇接觸過好似我哋自己嘅土地同時代噉嘅變態同被捕嘅危險。喺最需要主動生活嘅時候，城市生活就增加咗誘惑、早產、久坐嘅職業同被動刺激，早期嘅解放同對義務同紀律嘅感覺減弱，急於知道同做所有適合嘅事，令到人類嘅財富突然被重新打造 青年 —— 所有呢啲都缺乏一啲佢哋喺較保守嘅舊土地上仍然有嘅規管措施。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Sometimes I'm criticized in my own country for professing a belief in international norms and multilateral institutions. But I am convinced that in the long run, giving up some freedom of action -- not giving up our ability to protect ourselves or pursue our core interests, but binding ourselves to international rules over the long term -- enhances our security. And I think that's not just true for us.

jyutping: jau5 si4 hai2 ngo5 zi6 gei2 gwok3 gaa1，ngo5 jan1 wai6 soeng1 seon3 gwok3 zai3 kwai1 faan6 tung4 do1 bin1 gei1 gau3 ji4 bei6 pai1 ping4。daan6 ngo5 gin1 seon3，coeng4 jyun5 lai4 gong2，fong3 hei3 jat1 bou6 fan6 hang4 dung6 zi6 jau4——m4 hai6 fong3 hei3 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 waak6 zeoi1 kau4 wat6 sam1 lei6 jik1 ge3 nang4 lik6，ji4 hai6 coeng4 kei4 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 bong2 hai2 gwok3 zai3 kwai1 zak1 zi1 soeng6——kei4 sat6 wui6 zang1 koeng4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 on1 cyun4。ngo5 gok3 dak1 nei1 go3 m4 daan1 zi2 sik1 jung6 jyu1 ngo5 dei6，deoi3 kei4 taa1 gwok3 gaa1 dou1 jat1 joeng6。
text: 有時喺我自己國家，我因為相信國際規範同多邊機構而被批評。但我堅信，長遠嚟講，放棄一部分行動自由——唔係放棄保護自己或追求核心利益嘅能力，而係長期將自己綁喺國際規則之上——其實會增強我哋嘅安全。我覺得呢個唔單止適用於我哋，對其他國家都一樣。
